newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks seen moving narrowly, lack factors.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks seen moving narrowly, lack factors.

text.p: Tokyo stocks are likely to move narrowly in the Thursday trading session, searching for concrete direction, brokers said. They said that there are hopes for a rebound as the Nikkei average has fallen for three straight sessions, but the market lacked factors to move on.
On Wednesday, the Nikkei 225 slipped 26.51 points or 0.13 percent to end at 20,130.51. September Nikkei futures ended down 50 at 20,130.
"The Nikkei average fell beneath 20,000 on Wednesday, sparking bargain-hunting," a broker at a "Big Four" brokerage said. "The downside seems to be fairly firm."
